item.description: Singapore’s ministers will receive progressive salary increases, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong has announced. item.title: North Korea and Russia open first road bridge linking both countries
item.description: North Korea and Russia opened their first road bridge on Monday in a carefully choreographed display of friendship. The structure, which crosses the Tumen river, has been cast by both sides as an important milestone ‌in their deepening strategic partnership. The first flag-adorned trucks trundled across the 1km (0.6-mile) long two-lane bridge as Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin and North Korea’s Premier Pak Thae Song tuned in by video link to address workers and government officials from... item.title: Beata Wojna: "La victoria del AfD podría ser señal de fortaleza de la derecha radical en Europa"
item.description: El partido ultraderechista AfD ganó las elecciones regionales en Sajonia-Anhalt con el 44,5% de los votos, quedando al borde de la mayoría absoluta. El resultado abre la posibilidad de que el partido gobierne por primera vez un estado alemán, de ser así, podría ser un precedente del fortalecimiento de la derecha radical. Beata Wojna, analista internacional, doctora y profesora de Relaciones Internacionales en el Tec de Monterrey, analiza el tema en France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: El Grand Pacific Hotel es una antigua institución colonial británica situada en el corazón de la capital de Fiyi. Las brisas tropicales soplan desde el puerto y atraviesan sus terrazas encaladas hasta llegar al parlamento, al otro lado de la calle. item.description: Counter-measures covering several sectors come after Trump announced 50% tariffs on Canadian goods Canada is set to impose retaliatory tariffs on billions of dollars’ worth of American imports early on Tuesday, escalating a trade fight with its largest trading partner as tensions between US president Donald Trump and Canadian prime minister Mark Carney intensify. The tariffs, which take effect at 12.01am on Tuesday, will range from 15% to 50% and apply to products covering C$27.6bn in imports from the US. item.title: Tras la histórica victoria de AfD en Alemania, así reaccionan políticos y ciudadanos en las calles
item.description: Tras el triunfo de AfD en los comicios regionales de Sajonia-Anhalt, los dirigentes políticos reaccionaron al histórico resultado alcanzado por el partido de extrema derecha. Ulrich Siegmund se refirió a cómo podría alcanzar el apoyo necesario para convertirse en ministro presidente, ya que su partido quedó a solo tres escaños de la mayoría absoluta. Por su parte, el canciller Friedrich Merz reconoció la peor derrota histórica de la CDU, que gobernaba la región desde 1990. En las calles, los ciudadanos tienen una visión dividida. item.title: Live: Germany’s far-right AfD starts talks to form absolute majority
item.description: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) on Monday said it had started talks with “individual parliamentary groups or individual MPs” to form an absolute majority in Saxony-Anhalt's parliament following yesterday's election victory. Germany's domestic intelligence agency classifies the AfD as an extremist group, and other parties have previously refused to work with it. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Make home ownership a 5-year plan goal, Legco president says
item.description: Hong Kong authorities should make raising home ownership a goal of the city’s first five-year plan, Legislative Council president Starry Lee Wai-king has said, following a visit to a public estate with the housing minister. Lee also said the goal could be achieved by reviving a scheme that allowed public housing tenants to buy their flats and reserving subsidised homes for youth and middle-class families.
